meta.title: The firm — Rick Rodriguez
meta.description: Rodriguez & Associates Advisory Group: the firm Rick founded in Los Angeles in 1992, what it does, whom it serves and who works there.

sections.label: The firm
sections.quote: The firm Rick founded in 1992, <t>and still leads.</t>
sections.sub: Rodriguez & Associates Advisory Group, downtown Los Angeles: workouts and restructuring, capital and real estate, and expert work for counsel.

items.t: In 1992, after thirteen years at Security Pacific, the last two as Senior Vice President over a classified real estate portfolio of about $1.6 billion.
items.d: The firm began where that work left off: resolving complex debtor-creditor transactions secured by real estate, stock and partnership interests.

items.t: Founder and Principal since 1992. The firm’s own pages credit its work to him by name.
items.d: Workout strategies for lenders, bid pricing for loan and REO pools, and capital raised through his contacts in the mortgage market.

items.t: Expert witness work and litigation support for counsel are engaged through Rodriguez & Associates.
items.d: With Emily Rodriguez, Partner, on discovery analysis, research, trial exhibits, expert reports and declarations.

sections.label: What the firm does
sections.title: Four lines of work, <t>one principal.</t>
sections.lede: The firm’s twelve services, grouped by who they serve. As described on its website and in Rick’s 2016 CV.

cards.label: For lenders and borrowers
cards.title: Workouts and restructuring
cards.desc: Workout and debt restructure strategies for single loans or entire portfolios, in judicial and non-judicial settings.

cards.label: For counsel
cards.title: Expert witness and litigation support
cards.desc: Testimony in banking, finance and real estate, and support through every stage of a case.

cards.label: For developers and investors
cards.title: Capital and real estate
cards.desc: Capital for acquisitions and refinancing, and the feasibility of new projects.

cards.label: For banks
cards.title: Advisory to financial institutions
cards.desc: Portfolio and credit work from someone who ran it inside the bank.
items: Portfolio risk and lender liability exposure
